subject.title: [Bug]: Browser interactions can exhaust model context by injecting too much page content

question: Should the browser tool make compact goal-shaped reads and post-action change reports the default, and what full-page escape hatch should remain?
rationale: Current source shows partial caps and opt-in efficient mode, but changing the default model-facing browser contract needs maintainer intent and live calibration.

options.title: Default Compact Browser Reads
options.body: Make compact interactive snapshots and action change reports the default while preserving explicit raw snapshot or maxChars requests for full-page inspection.

options.title: Keep Efficient Mode Opt-In
options.body: Leave current defaults and improve docs/skill guidance so agents and users choose efficient snapshots for noisy browser tasks.

options.title: Benchmark Before Direction
options.body: Require a focused live browser benchmark before choosing the permanent default and then split the work into narrower follow-ups.

recommendation.title: Default Compact Browser Reads
recommendation.body: Make compact interactive snapshots and action change reports the default while preserving explicit raw snapshot or maxChars requests for full-page inspection.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent browser action contract work is the closest history signal for choosing action-result and snapshot interaction semantics.
